name: pi-pocket-change-atlas
description: Pi maps a pull request, branch, commit range, or local changes into an interactive visual report, for Pi Pocket.
author: Tanner Middleton

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node --check change-atlas/index.js && node --check change-atlas/report.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --tab-width 4 --print-width 100 change-atlas.ts change-atlas/*.js change-atlas/report.css test/*.ts README.md package.json
